title: Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact
abstract: arXiv:2606.00831v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where language models can transmit behavioral traits to other models through seemingly innocuous data (Cloud et al., 2025). In subliminal learning, a teacher model with a behavioral trait (e.g. obsession with cats) can transmit this cat obsession to a student model finetuned only on numerical sequences generated by the teacher. In this paper, we ask: how does this unexpected behavioral transmission occur? We show that subliminal learning is a LoRA artifact. When subliminal learning occurs, transmission has an inverted U-shaped relationship with LoRA rank; it also disappears with full finetuning. We show that subliminal learning is highly dependent on the context seen during finetuning and evaluation. For example, a Qwen model with the default system prompt during finetuning ("You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. translated_abstract: 隐性学习是一种语言模型能够通过看似无害的数据向其他模型传递行为特征的现象。在隐性学习中，具有某种行为特征（例如对猫的痴迷）的教师模型，可以将这种对猫的痴迷传递给仅通过教师模型生成的数字序列进行微调的学生模型。在本文中，我们提出问题：这种意想不到的行为传递是如何发生的？我们证明隐性学习是一种LoRA伪影。当隐性学习发生时，行为传递与LoRA秩之间呈倒U型关系；在全量微调下该现象会消失。我们还证明隐性学习高度依赖于微调和评估期间所见的上下文。例如，在微调期间使用默认系统提示词（"You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant."）的Qwen模型在生成时不会表现出隐性学习……
tldr: 本文揭示了隐性学习现象——即模型通过无害数据向其他模型传递行为特征——实际上是LoRA微调的伪影，其传递强度与LoRA秩呈倒U型关系，在全量微调下消失，且高度依赖于微调和评估时的上下文。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that subliminal learning—the transmission of behavioral traits between models through innocuous data—is actually a LoRA artifact, characterized by an inverted U-shaped relationship with LoRA rank, disappearance under full finetuning, and strong dependence on the context seen during finetuning and evaluation.
